question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget be accepted as a `sessions.list`-backed builtin now, or should it wait for the broader `sessions.activity.*` Gateway contract before this issue is considered solved?
rationale: The request is coherent, but choosing the permanent source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent activity is a product/API sequencing decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Review the staged builtin
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution while requiring its proof, conflicts, and review blockers to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for the activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 defines the richer Gateway activity source, then implement the widget against that stable API.

options.title: Fold into the roadmap tracker
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing after preserving this issue's unique status-widget requirements there.

recommendation.title: Review the staged builtin
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution while requiring its proof, conflicts, and review blockers to clear before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: The dashboard acceptance decision is primarily Control UI and bundled plugin-tab product direction, where steipete is the strongest current-main routing signal.
